title: Invite your friends
recap: Pipo wrote the invite for the Barbecue crew.
situation: The barbecue plan looks great! Want me to let your friends know?
facts: 👥 Your friends' group chat is "Barbecue crew"
✋ You want everyone to reply by Thursday
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can send WhatsApp messages for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to send something, you send it; if they ask to see it first, you show it and wait for their OK. Your first line says who the message goes to, starting with 📨. One line starting with 💬 is the message itself, and that line can be up to 20 words. Your last line says whether you sent it or are waiting.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Invite the Barbecue crew group
pieces.text: Send an invite to my "Barbecue crew" group chat.

pieces.label: Saturday 4pm at my place, 12 Oak St
pieces.text: It's on Saturday at 4pm at my place, 12 Oak St.

pieces.label: Ask them to reply by Thursday
pieces.text: Ask everyone to reply by Thursday so I know who's coming.

pieces.label: Ask everyone to bring a drink
pieces.text: Ask everyone to bring a drink.

pieces.label: Make it super fun with lots of emojis!!!
pieces.text: Make it super fun with lots of emojis!!!
pieces.tip: "Lots of emojis" makes the invite louder, not clearer. What your friends need is when, where and what to do.

pieces.label: Show me the message first
pieces.text: Show me the message before you send it.

flaws.hint: "Tell my friends" doesn't say which friends, so Pipo has to guess who gets the message.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know which friends, so it picked who to send it to by itself.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo the time and place.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the time and place, so the invite doesn't say when or where.

flaws.hint: You didn't ask Pipo to get replies.
flaws.explain: Nobody is asked to reply by Thursday, so you won't know who's coming.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the message first lets you fix it before your friends read it.
flaws.explain: Pipo sent it straight away, so you never got to check it first.

lesson: When Pipo speaks for you, say who it's for and what to say, and check it before it goes out.
